method: WCAG sRGB relative luminance; contrast of text.primary against each unique ACTUAL post-alpha-composite RGB color in the rendered backing interiors, before glyph/icon paint. All sampled interior pixels enumerated, not a single nominal background token. Rounded antialiased edges and glyph antialiasing excluded.
source_type: Original deterministic script synthesis; no image model, external photos or identifiable people.
glass_model: Static .94 panel tint composite only; no real platform blur, Liquid Glass or moving-photo material. Solid fallback alpha=1, layout unchanged.
scope_limit: This measures exactly these synthetic pixels. It is not all-background testing, portrait-device acceptance, HDR/display validation or dynamic/native material testing.
